text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Vodka, Cesario, and 
Sweep Tosho together. It looked like they 
were having a discussion...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's do this, prep time for the 
open campus!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The three of us got picked as guides, 
after all. Now that we've decided to do 
it, I ain't cutting any corners.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The classrooms, gymnasium, training 
courses... Let us make sure to guide the 
children thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First is this outdoor stage. It seems they 
will be holding a mini-live on the day.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! In that case, I'll blow everyone 
away with my magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll make the stage sparkle just like a 
starry sky! Everyone's gonna be totally 
enchanted♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Here goes— Panthus, panthus, agapanthus☆ 
Shine down, starlight~!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Did anything change at all?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmph...! This can't be! Fine, I'll pour in 
even more magical power...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Since it is bright out, twinkling like 
stars is difficult to see to begin with. 
The actual mini-live will be during the 
day as well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Then they should just hold the live 
after it gets dark! I'm absolutely, 
definitely showing off my magic!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely, but... there is a set 
schedule. Covering this entire area with 
blackout curtains... is also far too 
difficult given how wide it is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. If that's the case, how about we 
try a different spell?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like, turning the stage into a world of 
ice or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A world of ice? ...What's that about?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You sing your heart out cool-like 
surrounded by icicles! A soul-stirring 
shout echoing so loud it sets your core 
ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And the punchline goes like this! "I'll 
melt this whole world down with my blazing 
red heart"... or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, putting the line aside, that's not 
a bad idea. Then how about something like 
this?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Making ice crystals rain down like diamond 
dust!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... oooh!! What the heck, that sounds 
badass!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then let's bring out an aurora too, an 
aurora! I'll thrust my fist up, and right 
above it, a dazzling sky spreads out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's great! Then I'll summon 
penguins and polar bears too! Nothing is 
impossible for magic, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... with a live show like that, the 
children would surely be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Right, Sweep?! Man, magic gets your blood 
pumping this much!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A whole world of ice might be tough, 
though. Let's brainstorm together on a 
kind of magic that'll make the kids' eyes 
sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Fufun. Looks like you've finally come 
to understand the greatness of magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I have no choice! I'll let you 
guys help out too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Sweep-san seems quite eager now. It is 
all thanks to your encouragement, 
Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've got a younger brother and 
sister, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If their mood gets ruined, they instantly 
sulk. Kinda reminded me of the old days... 
Heheh!
